create_contact.description: Add a new contact to your Loops audience, with optional properties and mailing-list subscriptions.
create_contact.name: create_contact

parameters.description: The contact's email address (Loops' unique identifier for a contact).
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The contact's first name.
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: The contact's last name.
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Your app's own unique identifier for this user. Lets you find and update the contact later by user id.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: A group to segment the contact into, e.g. 'Founders' or 'Trial'. Used to target automations and lists.
parameters.name: user_group

parameters.description: Whether the contact is subscribed to marketing email. New contacts default to subscribed in Loops.
parameters.name: subscribed

parameters.description: Mailing lists to subscribe or unsubscribe the contact from, as a map of mailing-list id to true/false, e.g. {"cmXXXXt0": true}. Find list ids in Loops under Settings > Mailing lists (or via the API).
parameters.name: mailing_lists

parameters.description: Any custom contact properties to set, as an object, e.g. {"plan": "pro", "signupSource": "web"}. Loops creates a custom property automatically the first time it sees one.
parameters.name: properties

delete_contact.description: Remove a contact from your Loops audience by email, for offboarding or a data-deletion request.
delete_contact.name: delete_contact

parameters.description: The email address of the contact to delete.
parameters.name: email

find_contact.description: Look up a contact by email and return their properties and mailing-list subscriptions.
find_contact.name: find_contact

parameters.description: The email address of the contact to find.
parameters.name: email

send_event.description: Send a lifecycle event for a contact to trigger a Loops automation (a 'loop'). Creates the contact if it doesn't exist.
send_event.name: send_event

parameters.description: The email address of the contact the event is for.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The name of the event, e.g. 'signup' or 'trialStarted'. This is what your Loops automations listen for.
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.description: Optional data to attach to the event, as an object, e.g. {"plan": "pro"}. Available in the automation and email templates.
parameters.name: event_properties

parameters.description: Optional contact properties to set on the contact at the same time, as an object.
parameters.name: contact_properties

parameters.description: Optional mailing lists to subscribe or unsubscribe the contact from, as a map of mailing-list id to true/false.
parameters.name: mailing_lists

update_contact.description: Update a contact's properties or mailing-list subscriptions by email. Creates the contact if it doesn't exist yet.
update_contact.name: update_contact

parameters.description: The contact's email address (Loops' unique identifier for a contact).
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The contact's first name.
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: The contact's last name.
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Your app's own unique identifier for this user. Lets you find and update the contact later by user id.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: A group to segment the contact into, e.g. 'Founders' or 'Trial'. Used to target automations and lists.
parameters.name: user_group

parameters.description: Whether the contact is subscribed to marketing email. New contacts default to subscribed in Loops.
parameters.name: subscribed

parameters.description: Mailing lists to subscribe or unsubscribe the contact from, as a map of mailing-list id to true/false, e.g. {"cmXXXXt0": true}. Find list ids in Loops under Settings > Mailing lists (or via the API).
parameters.name: mailing_lists

parameters.description: Any custom contact properties to set, as an object, e.g. {"plan": "pro", "signupSource": "web"}. Loops creates a custom property automatically the first time it sees one.
parameters.name: properties

description: Automate Loops: create, find, update, and delete contacts, and trigger lifecycle automations with events.
